flows:
Navigate to https://tfl.gov.uk/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
If a CAPTCHA or access challenge appears, @v16:"stop and report it".
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
First, press Tab twice in the page before evaluating focusability.
Continue using Tab and Shift+Tab to reach the target.
If a cookie dialog covers the page, @v16:"check Accept only essential cookies is keyboard focusable and activate it".
then check the Plan a journey link is in sequential keyboard focus order, activate it, and verify the journey planner page or form is visible.

summary:
You asked to use the keyboard to reach and open the Plan a journey link on the Transport for London website.
After tabbing twice, a cookie settings dialog was present and its essential-cookies option was reachable and activated using the keyboard.
Continued navigating with Tab and Shift+Tab to reach the Plan a journey link; it was available in the normal keyboard sequence.
Activated the link with the keyboard and arrived at the Plan a journey page, where the journey planner form is visible.
